zoe-partner-eng: Partner asks for a compact "starter-iac" showing k8s inference + autoscaling + VPC isolation for the marketplace listing. Wants both AWS and GCP examples and a one-page runbook. Can we agree on module boundaries?

ken-devex: Keep it minimal: modules/network, modules/cluster, modules/inference, modules/kms. No provider blocks inside modules. Examples at examples/aws and examples/gcp. Add README with quick deploy steps and cost estimate.

maya-arch: Important: inference module must accept routing_mode (hosted|dedicated), enable_hsm boolean, and firewall_profiles. Diagram: I'll add a compact SVG to docs/arch.svg. Also add security checklist (IAM scopes, artifact scanning).

leo-terraform: I'll scaffold modules with variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md. Outputs to include: cluster_endpoint, kubeconfig_raw, network_id, static_ips. Will add example main.tf showing how to disable the cluster autoscaler for low-latency setups.

ci-bot: CI template created for repo: https://ci.internal/redwood/marketplace-starter (tfsec + terratest) :white_check_mark:

zoe-partner-eng: Great. Plan: leo PR by Tue EOD, review Wed, partner walkthrough next Fri. Action items assigned. :thumbsup:
